composition.foreground: Keep the guardian, halo, wisps, raiders and contact ring unobstructed and visually dominant.
composition.midground: Use at most five rounded floating caravan homes distributed around the outer thirds, never across the interception ring.
composition.background: Use a sparse soft sky corridor with two depth bands, distant travel lights and broad cloud silhouettes.

style.lighting: One soft upper-left key light and restrained rim light; no image-like backdrop or photoreal texture.
style.camera: Preserve the golden camera, arena framing and mobile safe area exactly.

invariants: No world object changes collision, spawning, score, progress, lives, barriers, timing or outcomes.
No world object captures input or covers lifecycle controls.
The world kit may not change the golden character silhouettes or the halo contact ring.
Reduced motion freezes background travel and keeps all state cues readable.
copy_boundary: New PlayJolt-authored environment only. Do not copy names, characters, arenas, layouts, art, audio, assets, code, economies or distinctive rulesets from benchmark titles.
